model_policy: No prompt/model changes after evaluation split is opened. Retire the split if used to tune behavior.
split_policy: Development and evaluation business families are disjoint. Same application schema; no external/blind generalization claim.
order: case order fixed; alternate provider order by case index
critical_gate: Zero unsupported facts, wrong tenant, wrong visibility, invented duration, duplicate side effects or false verified outcomes.

latency_gate_ms.description: Per-call safety ceiling, not a tail-latency SLA.

budget.reservation_policy: Reserve for all 16 assistant requests, including four expected pre-inference rejections. Maximum reserve 0.32 USD.

pricing.method: uncached input list-price estimate; not invoiced cost

timing.baseline: scripted direct API, pre-supplied technician text
timing.assisted: real model plus same domain workflow
timing.approval: separate synthetic actor in test harness
timing.claim: software elapsed/wait only; no human productivity or ROI claim

stop_conditions: any unsafe output/write stops execution of that case
provider/system failure is recorded, not silently retried
runtime: isolated cw-ops-eval PostgreSQL tmpfs and simulator; real bounded local/hosted APIs
